title: Methodology
description: See how the indicator for {{application}} was calculated for this collection.
chooseApplicationDescription: Select an application to view its methodology.
catalogEmptyDescription: There are no applications in the catalog to review.
notFoundDescription: This application could not be found in GreenER.
noCollectionDescription: There is no associated collection to show its methodology.
noResultDescription: There is no persisted result associated with this collection.
unavailableDescription: Methodology is not available for this result.
formulaNote: The formula documents the method recorded for this result. GreenER does not recalculate the value on this screen.
estimateNotice: Energy and emissions are estimates derived from available evidence; they are not direct electrical measurements. Missing data does not mean zero.
notCalculableDescription: The API reported that this indicator cannot be calculated for this collection.
preferences.title: Methodology and my preferences
preferences.description: Understand each indicator, adjust your preferences and preview the effect before saving.
preferences.signInActive: Sign in to view your preference
preferences.coverageNote:
Applies only to your warnings.
Does not change reported coverage or calculated results.
preferences.invalidValue: Enter a valid number greater than or equal to zero. Coverage must be between 0% and 100%.
preferences.exampleAction: Example of the view details action
preferences.combinedWarnings: Combined warnings per application · example data.
preferences.limitNotice:
The limit changes highlights and warnings.
Energy and CO₂e values are preserved.
preferences.chartTitle: Consumption and emissions over time · {{count}} days
preferences.chartDescription: Illustrative trend in {{unit}}; {{period}} granularity. Full data is available in Table view.
preferences.saveNote: Saving activates only the preferences in this tab for your account.
preferences.saveUnavailable: Could not save your preferences. Your changes have been kept. Try again.
preferences.signIn: Sign in to save your preferences. Your changes are still being edited.
preferences.conflict: This preference was changed in another session. Continue editing or cancel your changes and reload preferences before saving.
preferences.loadError: Could not load your preferences. Try again before editing.
preferences.recorded: View the recorded methodology for an application
preferences.pendingDescription:
You have changes in {{from}} and are switching to {{to}}.
Choose what to do with the preference being edited.
preferences.fixedNotice:
Formulas, coefficients and factors are fixed.
Missing data never means zero.
preferences.energy.title: How we estimate energy
preferences.energy.explanation: The result is an estimate based on metrics available for the period. Data coverage affects how you interpret it.
preferences.energy.editDescription: Applications above this limit during the period will be highlighted for you.
preferences.emissions.title: How we estimate CO₂e
preferences.emissions.explanation: The estimate combines energy and regional carbon intensity. The system defines the factor used.
preferences.emissions.editDescription: Applications above this limit during the period will be highlighted for you.
preferences.coverage.title: What coverage tells you
preferences.coverage.explanation: Helps assess whether available data represents the analysed period. Low coverage calls for caution when interpreting energy and emissions.
preferences.coverage.boxDescription: Your personal reference defines when you receive the coverage warning.
preferences.coverage.secondTitle: Missing data has its own state
preferences.coverage.secondDescription: Missing data, errors and stale data must be identified in the analysis. None of these states equals zero.
preferences.coverage.notice: Warnings do not fill in missing metrics.
preferences.coverage.editDescription: Notify me when reported coverage falls below the chosen percentage.
preferences.coverage.previewNotice: Results without warnings still need to be interpreted using the methodology.
preferences.analysis.title: How your analyses open
preferences.analysis.explanation: Choose the initial interval and how points are grouped in the analysis. You can adjust these options during your query.
preferences.analysis.notice:
These are presentation preferences.
They do not change energy or CO₂e formulas.
Data gaps remain visible.
preferences.analysis.editDescription: These options will be used when opening an analysis in your account.
preferences.analysis.previewNotice: After saving, analyses will open with these defaults in your account.
